d: Pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ke lie khud ko 'hanuman' batane vale kendriy mantri aur LJP (Ram Vilas) ke adhyaksh Chirag Paswan ab Uttar Pradesh ki rajniti men apni parti ka vistar karne ki taiyari men hain. ABP News ke shikhar sammelan men die intravyu men Chirag Paswan ne PM Modi ke sath apne rishte, BJP ke sath gathbandhan aur UP men 2027 ke vidhanasbha chunav ko lekar khulkar bat ki.
